content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for HSPCB Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 01-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for HSPCB Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is 01-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: HSPCB has announced a total of 76 vacancies for various posts on deputation. These vacancies are spread across different positions within the organization.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for HSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for HSPCB Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the posts in HSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary for the posts ranges from Level 2 to Level 19, as per the 7th Pay Commission. Specific salary details for each post are mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for HSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary for different posts. They range from M.Sc. in various disciplines, B.E./B.Tech, PhD, Graduate in any discipline, to M.Com/B.Com. Detailed qualifications are listed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for HSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for HSPCB Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for HSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts is based on deputation. Candidates will be selected based on their eligibility and suitability for deputation to the respective posts.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the official notification for HSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for HSPCB Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article or from the official website of HSPCB.

faq.question: Q9. What is the last date for the notification release?
faq.answer: The notification for HSPCB Recruitment 2026 was released on 3 September 2026.

faq.answer: The job location for HSPCB Recruitment 2026 is Panchkula, Haryana.
